title: Sharp Causal Bounds from Causal Order Alone via Predecessor Equality Partitions
banked_reason: D0.5.G cold referee: delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field; paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4 and not salvageable within scope. Dedicated math review passed with no findings.
gap_reasons: The Bell(h) theorem is confined to unrestricted complete-predecessor mechanisms and does not extend to prescribed sparse graphs, factorized exogeneity, cycles, or succinct nested queries.

The only demonstrated computational separation is against a deliberately path-retaining numeric-history baseline, while no implementation or benchmark establishes gains over competitive reduced representations on substantive counterfactual-bound problems.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and independently math-checked exact equality-partition continuation, alphabet-independent single and joint compiler bounds, sparse attaining witnesses, sharp cellwise endpoints, and Bell(h) residual-state minimality. Several false Bell(h-1) and concrete-common-table residual formulations were rejected and repaired before the final math review passed. The package nevertheless missed the field novelty floor because its model scope and baseline-only separation lacked a sparse/multi-regime extension or competitive implementation evidence.
tldr: For standard finite order-compatible recursive structural causal models with arbitrary predecessor parent subsets and shared exogenous variation, sourced causal-order canonicalization permits sharp-bound optimization over a saturated all-predecessor response carrier. A deterministic normalizer extracts exactly the predecessor-only contexts retained by the query, and their complete-prefix equality partition is an exact continuation state. For the existential-support residual, in which each prefix may use its own response completion, this state is worst-case minimal: a binary selector construction realizes and pairwise separates all \(\operatorname{Bell}(h)\) partitions while the factual zero path remains outside the retained context set. Representative transitions give exact single-conjunction and joint-score compilers with exponential factors independent of alphabet cardinality, and sparse traceback attains the sharp observational cell-sum endpoints.
gap: The closest exact order-only method proves canonical equivalence between parent-subset recursive models and complete all-predecessor response carriers, then enumerates completed response signatures before quotienting them by observational and query evaluations, leaving an alphabet-product optimization space. It does not establish either a value-preserving predecessor normal form for a prefix compiler or complete-prefix equality as an exact local continuation state.
fill: The project keeps the standard parent-subset SCM class as its target, invokes the sourced canonical-carrier equivalence, proves the deterministic normalization lemma and equality-type continuation theorem on that carrier, derives complete representative transitions and explicit \(h\)- and \(r\)-dependent bounds, reconstructs sparse response systems, certifies sharp endpoints for the standard class, and gives a self-contained pin-resistant separation against the defined numeric-history baseline without claiming universal decision-diagram optimality.
